submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.89 ns among all tested configurations. This represents a significant performance improvement over G3 (1.315 ns at 2mm) and G1 (1.989 ns at 2mm). The 2mm gap is optimal for G2, providing better performance than both the 1mm gap (1.108 ns) and 3mm gap (1.021 ns). This configuration meets all constraints: it uses one of the three candidate mixtures, falls within the 1-3mm gap requirement, and is expected to comply with laboratory safety policies given the available 90% gas recirculation recovery system. The choice directly optimizes for the stated goal of achieving the best possible time resolution.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 at 2mm gap achieves 0.89 ns, which is the lowest time resolution across all simulated configurations (G1, G2, G3 at gaps of 1mm, 2mm, and 3mm)

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 is one of the three candidate mixtures (G1, G2, G3) available for selection
Recommended gap of 2mm is within the specified 1-3mm range

requirements.requirement: The gas system must comply with the laboratory's environmental and safety policies
requirements.evidence: Gas recirculation recovery system available at 90% efficiency supports environmental compliance; HV requirement (≤12 kV) is within operational limits
